headline_of_the_week: Female founders posted their second-best funding quarter ever in Q2 2026 at $73.2B, but 89% flowed to one company (Anthropic), while the UK Invest in Women Taskforce crossed $115M deployed across 22 deals

headlines.title: Female founders raise $73.2B in Q2 2026, second-best quarter ever, but 89% is one company
headlines.summary: PitchBook data reported in Inc. shows female-founded companies raised $73.2B in Q2 2026, the second-highest quarter on record. The catch: Anthropic (Daniela Amodei) alone accounts for ~$65B (89%) of that total. Underneath the headline number the median female-founder round remains under-funded versus the market baseline.

headlines.title: UK Invest in Women Taskforce surpasses $115M deployed across 22 deals
headlines.summary: Debbie Wosskow CBE confirmed the Invest in Women Taskforce has deployed £115M+ across 22 deals under an £18B commitment. Deployment rate ~1.75%, but crossing the $100M threshold marks the first significant proof point for the largest women-founder capital pool in the UK.

headlines.title: World Bank identifies 49 structural barriers facing women entrepreneurs in Eastern Europe & Central Asia
headlines.summary: New World Bank report maps 49 distinct barriers holding back women-led SMEs across Eastern Europe and Central Asia, from collateral requirements to procurement gatekeeping to informal-sector lock-in. Sets the intervention agenda for LP allocators and DFI capital in the region.

headlines.title: Swiss SECA H1 2026: only 7% of Swiss VC capital went to female-CEO startups
headlines.summary: Swiss Private Equity & Corporate Finance Association (SECA) H1 2026 data shows just 7% of Swiss venture capital was deployed to startups with a female CEO. Swiss ecosystem lags the DACH average and reinforces the case for gender-lens LP mandates in the region.

headlines.title: Citation Capital closes $1.2B - largest female-led PE fund of 2026
headlines.summary: Citation Capital (Laurie Hagge and Tricia Glynn Hudson) closed a $1.2B growth-equity fund, the largest female-led private equity fund of the year. Institutional LPs backed a female-led GP at a scale that materially changes the female-GP ceiling in growth PE.

headlines.title: Global women's health investment enters $1.55B era of scale - Forbes
headlines.summary: Forbes analysis of the FemHealth Ventures 2026 report concludes global women's health investment has crossed a structural threshold at $1.55B annualized, calling it the sector's era of scale. US investor pace slowed but global capital picked up the slack. Sector-thesis validation for allocators.

headlines.title: Women TechEU reopens with 4 cutoffs, first cutoff July 21
headlines.summary: The European Innovation Council relaunched Women TechEU 2. Rolling submissions with 4 cutoffs across the next 12 months. First cutoff is Tuesday July 21, 2026. €75K lump sum plus 6 months coaching for female deeptech founders in EU/associated countries.

headlines.title: Israel closes H1 2026 with $8.4-8.6B raised across 129 rounds
headlines.summary: Israeli tech H1 2026 closed at $8.4-8.6B across 129 rounds. Notable female-founder rounds this week: Noa Argamani joined Vine Ventures as EIR; multiple femtech and health rounds in the pipeline. Israeli women-founder share still tracks below global average.
